title: Light Jog and Shake-Out
description: A very easy closing jog combined with shaking out the arms and legs, helping flush out fatigue before players leave practice.

content.objective: Help the body transition out of high effort with gentle movement rather than stopping abruptly.
content.setup: The group jogs together at an easy pace around the court.
instructions: Jog one easy lap of the court as a group, well below practice intensity.
Stop and shake out both arms loosely for 15 seconds.
Shake out each leg loosely for 15 seconds per side.
Finish with a few slow, deep breaths before leaving the court.
coachingPoints: Keep the jog genuinely easy — this is recovery, not more conditioning.
Let the shaking be loose and relaxed, not tense.
Use this moment to let the energy settle before players leave.
commonMistakes: Turning the easy jog into another conditioning sprint out of habit.
Rushing through the shake-out instead of actually relaxing the muscles.
Treating it as optional instead of part of the session.
content.safety: Make sure the jogging lane is clear of any remaining equipment.
